name: services/events2/send_notification
description: Send custom notification to selected user
brief_description: Send custom notification to selected user

arguments.name: message_pl
arguments.description: Message in polish language that will be displayed to a user

arguments.name: user_ids
arguments.description: List of users who will be notified. Note that parameters user_id and users_ids cannot be used thogether

arguments.name: message_en
arguments.description: Message in english language that will be displayed to a user

arguments.name: event_type_id
arguments.description: Event type of notification to send

arguments.name: send_after
arguments.description: Datetime string - if used, notification will be delayed to selected time

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: JSON object with data that will be send in notification

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
